apis.name: GlideRecord
apis.description: The primary class for database operations in ServiceNow. GlideRecord provides an object-oriented way to query, insert, update, and delete records without writing SQL. It supports complex queries with encoded query strings, join queries, aggregate-like patterns, and full CRUD lifecycle hooks via Business Rules.

methods.name: addQuery
methods.description: Adds a filter to the query. Can take two or three arguments (field, value) or (field, operator, value).

methods.name: addEncodedQuery
methods.description: Adds a filter using a ServiceNow encoded query string (the string found in a breadcrumb).

methods.name: addOrCondition
methods.description: Adds an OR condition to the previous query filter.
methods.example:
var qc = gr.addQuery('state', '1');
qc.addOrCondition('state', '2');

methods.name: addJoinQuery
methods.description: Adds a join query to another table.

methods.name: addNullQuery
methods.description: Adds a query for fields that are null (empty).
methods.example: gr.addNullQuery('short_description');

methods.name: addNotNullQuery
methods.description: Adds a query for fields that are NOT null.
methods.example: gr.addNotNullQuery('assigned_to');

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a single record by sys_id or by a field/value pair. Returns true if found.

methods.name: query
methods.description: Executes the query against the database.

methods.name: next
methods.description: Moves to the next record in the result set. Returns true if another record exists.

methods.name: insert
methods.description: Inserts a new record into the database.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates the current record in the database.

methods.name: deleteRecord
methods.description: Deletes the current record.

methods.name: deleteMultiple
methods.description: Deletes ALL records matching the current query. WARNING: Cannot be undone, does not trigger per-record business rules. Always verify your query with getRowCount() before calling.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Creates an empty record and populates it with default field values from the dictionary. Use before setting values and calling insert().

methods.name: newRecord
methods.description: Creates a new record with default values and immediately assigns a sys_id. Unlike initialize(), the sys_id is available before insert.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Gets the string value of a field.
methods.example: var desc = gr.getValue('short_description');

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Sets the value of a field.

methods.name: getDisplayValue
methods.description: Gets the user-friendly display value of a field (e.g., name instead of sys_id for references).
methods.example: gs.info(gr.getDisplayValue('caller_id'));

methods.name: getRowCount
methods.description: Returns the number of records returned by the query.

methods.name: setLimit
methods.description: Limits the number of records returned by the query.

methods.name: orderBy
methods.description: Orders the results by the specified field in ascending order.

methods.name: orderByDesc
methods.description: Orders the results by the specified field in descending order.
methods.example: gr.orderByDesc('sys_created_on');

methods.name: canWrite
methods.description: Checks if the current user has permission to write to this record/table.
methods.example: if (gr.canWrite()) { gr.update(); }

methods.name: canRead
methods.description: Checks if the current user has permission to read this record/table.

methods.name: setWorkflow
methods.description: Enables or disables the running of business rules, workflows, and engines for this operation.

methods.name: autoSysFields
methods.description: Enables or disables the automatic updating of system fields (sys_updated_by, sys_updated_on, etc.).
methods.example:
gr.autoSysFields(false);
gr.update();

methods.name: getUniqueValue
methods.description: Returns the sys_id of the current record.
methods.example: var sysId = gr.getUniqueValue();

methods.name: getTableName
methods.description: Returns the name of the table.

methods.name: isValidField
methods.description: Checks if the specified field exists in the table.
methods.example: if (gr.isValidField('u_custom_field')) { ... }

methods.name: getLink
methods.description: Returns a URL to the current record.

methods.name: hasNext
methods.description: Determines if there are any more records in the GlideRecord object.

methods.name: addActiveQuery
methods.description: Adds a query to filter only active records.

methods.name: getEncodedQuery
methods.description: Returns the encoded query string for the current GlideRecord query. Useful for debugging or passing queries between components.

methods.name: getElement
methods.description: Returns the GlideElement for the specified field. Provides access to field-level methods like getDisplayValue(), getReferenceTable(), and changes().

methods.name: isValid
methods.description: Returns true if the GlideRecord object is valid and the table exists.

methods.name: isValidRecord
methods.description: Returns true if the current record is valid (has been loaded with data via get/next).

methods.name: changes
methods.description: Returns true if any field on the record has been modified. Commonly used in Business Rules.

methods.name: isNewRecord
methods.description: Returns true if the record has never been inserted into the database.

methods.name: getRecordClassName
methods.description: Returns the actual table name of the record. Critical for extended tables (e.g., an incident record on the task table).

methods.name: setAbortAction
methods.description: Aborts the current database operation. Used in Business Rules to prevent insert/update/delete.

methods.name: chooseWindow
methods.description: Sets a range of records to return, enabling pagination. Parameters are firstRow and lastRow (zero-indexed).

methods.name: getLastErrorMessage
methods.description: Returns the last error message from a failed insert, update, or delete operation.

methods.name: setCategory
methods.description: Sets a category for the query, which can be used in Business Rules to determine query origin and improve performance.

methods.name: operation
methods.description: Returns the current database operation: insert, update, or delete. Used in Business Rules.

methods.name: getClassDisplayValue
methods.description: Returns the display value of the sys_class_name field (the human-readable table label).

methods.name: setForceUpdate
methods.description: Forces an update even if no fields have changed. Triggers business rules.

methods.name: isActionAborted
methods.description: Returns true if setAbortAction(true) was called on this record.

methods.name: setNewGuidValue
methods.description: Sets a specific sys_id for a record before insert (instead of auto-generated).

methods.name: applyTemplate
methods.description: Applies a record template to the current record.

methods.name: getFields
methods.description: Returns a Java ArrayList of all fields on the record.

methods.name: canDelete
methods.description: Returns true if the current user can delete this record.

methods.name: canCreate
methods.description: Returns true if the current user can create records in this table.

methods.name: getED
methods.description: Returns the GlideElementDescriptor for the specified field.

apis.name: GlideSystem (gs)
apis.description: The GlideSystem API provides a number of system methods that provide information about the system or currently logged in user.

methods.name: info
methods.description: Logs an informational message to the system log. Supports message formatting.
methods.example: gs.info('The value is {0}', someVar);

methods.name: warn
methods.description: Logs a warning message to the system log.
methods.example: gs.warn('This might be a problem');

methods.name: error
methods.description: Logs an error message to the system log.
methods.example: gs.error('Something went wrong: ' + err);

methods.name: debug
methods.description: Logs a debug-level message to the system log. Only visible when session debugging is enabled (Debug Business Rules, Debug Security, etc.).

methods.name: addInfoMessage
methods.description: Adds an informational message to the top of the screen for the user.
methods.example: gs.addInfoMessage('Saved successfully!');

methods.name: addErrorMessage
methods.description: Adds an error message to the top of the screen for the user.
methods.example: gs.addErrorMessage('Access Denied');

methods.name: getProperty
methods.description: Gets a value from the System Properties (sys_properties) table.
methods.example: var getGrp = gs.getProperty('custom.incidentP1.group');

methods.name: setProperty
methods.description: Sets a system property value.
methods.example: gs.setProperty('my.cool.prop', 'new_value');

methods.name: getUser
methods.description: Returns a GlideUser object for the currently logged-in user. Provides access to user details, roles, groups, and preferences.

methods.name: getUserID
methods.description: Returns the sys_id of the current user.

methods.name: getUserName
methods.description: Returns the username (user_name) of the current user.

methods.name: hasRole
methods.description: Checks if the current user has a specific role.
methods.example: if (gs.hasRole('itil')) { ... }

methods.name: getSession
methods.description: Returns a reference to the GlideSession object.
methods.example: var session = gs.getSession();

methods.name: nowDateTime
methods.description: Returns the current date and time in the user's display format.

methods.name: beginningOfLastMonth
methods.description: Returns the date and time for the beginning of last month.
methods.example: gr.addQuery('sys_created_on', '>', gs.beginningOfLastMonth());

methods.name: eventQueue
methods.description: Queues an event for the event manager.
methods.example: gs.eventQueue('incident.updated', current, gs.getUserID(), gs.getUserName());

methods.name: isInteractive
methods.description: Checks if the current session is interactive (user-driven) or background (e.g., job).
methods.example: if (gs.isInteractive()) { ... }

methods.name: isLoggedIn
methods.description: Checks if a user is logged in.

methods.name: getMessage
methods.description: Retrieves a translated message from the UI Messages table.
methods.example: var msg = gs.getMessage('hello_world');

methods.name: tableExists
methods.description: Checks if a table exists in the database.
methods.example: if (gs.tableExists('incident')) { ... }

methods.name: nil
methods.description: Checks if a value is null, empty string, or undefined.
methods.example: if (gs.nil(current.short_description)) { ... }

methods.name: eventQueueScheduled
methods.description: Queues an event to run at a specific time.
methods.example: gs.eventQueueScheduled('incident.reminder', current, parm1, parm2, new GlideDateTime());

methods.name: getUserDisplayName
methods.description: Returns the display name of the current user.
methods.example:
var displayName = gs.getUserDisplayName();
gs.info('Current user: ' + displayName);

methods.name: sleep
methods.description: Pauses the script for the specified number of milliseconds. Only use in background scripts or scheduled jobs — never in Business Rules.
methods.example:
// In a scheduled job or background script
gs.sleep(2000); // Wait 2 seconds

methods.name: generateGUID
methods.description: Generates a globally unique identifier (GUID/UUID).
methods.example:
var guid = gs.generateGUID();
gs.info('New GUID: ' + guid);

methods.name: getDisplayColumn
methods.description: Returns the display column name for a table.
methods.example:
var displayCol = gs.getDisplayColumn('incident');
gs.info(displayCol); // 'number'

methods.name: include
methods.description: Includes a Script Include for use in the current script context.
methods.example:
gs.include('PrototypeServer');
// Now functions from PrototypeServer are available

methods.name: daysAgo
methods.description: Returns a date/time value for N days ago. Useful for query filters.

methods.name: daysAgoStart
methods.description: Returns midnight at the start of N days ago.

methods.name: hoursAgo
methods.description: Returns a date/time value for N hours ago.

methods.name: minutesAgo
methods.description: Returns a date/time value for N minutes ago.

methods.name: beginningOfThisMonth
methods.description: Returns midnight on the first day of the current month.

methods.name: endOfLastMonth
methods.description: Returns the end of the last day of the previous month.

methods.name: urlEncode
methods.description: URL-encodes a string, replacing special characters with percent-encoded equivalents. Essential when building URLs with dynamic parameters.

methods.name: urlDecode
methods.description: Decodes a URL-encoded string back to its original form. Reverses the encoding applied by urlEncode().

methods.name: xmlToJSON
methods.description: Converts an XML string to a JSON object.
methods.example:
var json = gs.xmlToJSON('<root><item>value</item></root>');
gs.info(JSON.stringify(json));

methods.name: base64Encode
methods.description: Encodes a string to base64.
methods.example: var encoded = gs.base64Encode('Hello World');

methods.name: base64Decode
methods.description: Decodes a base64-encoded string.
methods.example: var decoded = gs.base64Decode(encoded);

methods.name: flushMessages
methods.description: Clears all pending info/error messages that have been queued with addInfoMessage() or addErrorMessage(). Messages already displayed are not affected.

methods.name: getCurrentScopeName
methods.description: Returns the name of the current application scope.
methods.example:
var scope = gs.getCurrentScopeName();
gs.info('Current scope: ' + scope); // 'global' or 'x_myapp'

methods.name: getCallerScopeName
methods.description: Returns the caller application scope name.
methods.example: var caller = gs.getCallerScopeName();

methods.name: setRedirect
methods.description: Redirects the user to the specified URL after the current script finishes.
methods.example: gs.setRedirect('incident_list.do?sysparm_query=active=true');

methods.name: isMobile
methods.description: Returns true if the user is accessing from a mobile device.

methods.name: isDebugging
methods.description: Returns true if debugging is enabled for the current session.

methods.name: getMaxSchemaNameLength
methods.description: Returns the maximum field name length for the database.
methods.example: gs.info('Max field name: ' + gs.getMaxSchemaNameLength());

methods.name: getNewAppScopeCompanyPrefix
methods.description: Returns the company prefix for scoped app naming.
methods.example:
var prefix = gs.getNewAppScopeCompanyPrefix();
gs.info('Prefix: ' + prefix);

methods.name: yearsAgo
methods.description: Returns a date/time for N years ago.

methods.name: monthsAgo
methods.description: Returns a date/time for N months ago.

methods.name: quartersAgoStart
methods.description: Returns midnight at the start of N quarters ago.

methods.name: beginningOfLastWeek
methods.description: Returns midnight at the start of last week.
methods.example: gr.addQuery('sys_created_on', '>=', gs.beginningOfLastWeek());

methods.name: endOfLastWeek
methods.description: Returns the end of last week.
methods.example: gr.addQuery('sys_created_on', '<=', gs.endOfLastWeek());

methods.name: beginningOfThisWeek
methods.description: Returns midnight at the start of this week.
methods.example: gr.addQuery('sys_created_on', '>=', gs.beginningOfThisWeek());

methods.name: beginningOfThisYear
methods.description: Returns midnight on January 1st of the current year.
methods.example: gr.addQuery('opened_at', '>=', gs.beginningOfThisYear());

methods.name: endOfLastYear
methods.description: Returns the last moment of December 31st of the previous year.
methods.example: gr.addQuery('closed_at', '<=', gs.endOfLastYear());

methods.name: beginningOfLastYear
methods.description: Returns midnight on January 1st of the previous year.
methods.example: gr.addQuery('opened_at', '>=', gs.beginningOfLastYear());

apis.name: GlideForm (g_form)
apis.description: Client-side API for manipulating the current form. Accessible via the global g_form variable in Client Scripts, UI Policies, and UI Actions (client-side). Provides methods for getting/setting field values, controlling visibility, mandatory state, decorations, and form-level messages.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Gets the value of a field on the form.
methods.example: var val = g_form.getValue('short_description');

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Sets the value of a field on the form. For reference fields, can take (field, sys_id, displayValue).

methods.name: clearValue
methods.description: Clears the value of a field.
methods.example: g_form.clearValue('assigned_to');

methods.name: setReadOnly
methods.description: Sets a field to read-only or editable.
methods.example: g_form.setReadOnly('number', true);

methods.name: setMandatory
methods.description: Sets a field as mandatory or not.
methods.example: g_form.setMandatory('priority', true);

methods.name: setDisplay
methods.description: Shows or hides a field and its container/label (reclaims space).
methods.example: g_form.setDisplay('u_hidden_field', false);

methods.name: setVisible
methods.description: Shows or hides a field but keeps the space reserved.
methods.example: g_form.setVisible('u_ghost_field', false);

methods.name: addInfoMessage
methods.description: Displays an info message at the top of the form.
methods.example: g_form.addInfoMessage('Welcome to the record');

methods.name: addErrorMessage
methods.description: Displays an error message at the top of the form.
methods.example: g_form.addErrorMessage('Please fix the following errors');

methods.name: showFieldMsg
methods.description: Displays a message directly under a specific field.
methods.example: g_form.showFieldMsg('caller_id', 'This user is on vacation', 'info');

methods.name: clearMessages
methods.description: Removes all informational and error messages displayed at the top of the form. Does not clear field-level messages (use hideFieldMsg for those).

methods.name: hideFieldMsg
methods.description: Hides field messages for a specific field.
methods.example: g_form.hideFieldMsg('caller_id');

methods.name: addOption
methods.description: Adds a choice to a choice list field.
methods.example: g_form.addOption('state', '10', 'In Review');

methods.name: removeOption
methods.description: Removes a choice from a choice list field.
methods.example: g_form.removeOption('priority', '1');

methods.name: clearOptions
methods.description: Removes all choices from a choice list.
methods.example: g_form.clearOptions('u_my_choice');

methods.name: getTableName
methods.description: Returns the table name of the current record.
methods.example: var table = g_form.getTableName();

methods.name: getUniqueValue
methods.description: Returns the sys_id of the current record.
methods.example: var id = g_form.getUniqueValue();

methods.name: isNewRecord
methods.description: Returns true if the record has not been saved yet.
methods.example: if (g_form.isNewRecord()) { ... }

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the current form without navigating away. Equivalent to clicking the Save button. The form stays open after saving.

methods.name: submit
methods.description: Submits the form, saving the record and navigating away (back to the list or previous page). Equivalent to clicking the Submit/Update button.

methods.name: flash
methods.description: Flashes the field label to draw attention.
methods.example: g_form.flash('priority', '#FFF000', 3);

methods.name: getReference
methods.description: Retrieves the GlideRecord of a reference field. Note: Use callback for best performance.

methods.name: getSections
methods.description: Returns an array of form sections.
methods.example: var sections = g_form.getSections();

methods.name: setSectionDisplay
methods.description: Shows or hides a form section.
methods.example: g_form.setSectionDisplay('notes', false);

methods.name: isMandatory
methods.description: Checks if a field is mandatory.
methods.example: var isMandatory = g_form.isMandatory('priority');

methods.name: hasField
methods.description: Checks if a field exists on the form.
methods.example: if (g_form.hasField('assigned_to')) { ... }

methods.name: getControl
methods.description: Gets the HTML element for a field.
methods.example: var control = g_form.getControl('caller_id');

methods.name: getOption
methods.description: Gets the HTML element for a specific option.
methods.example: var option = g_form.getOption('state', '6');

methods.name: showRelatedList
methods.description: Shows a specific related list on the form by its table name. The related list must be configured on the form.
methods.example:
// Show the child incidents related list
g_form.showRelatedList('incident.parent_incident');

methods.name: hideRelatedList
methods.description: Hides a specific related list on the form. The space is reclaimed and the list is no longer visible.

methods.name: getRelatedListNames
methods.description: Gets the names of all related lists on the form.
methods.example: var lists = g_form.getRelatedListNames();

methods.name: setDisabled
methods.description: Enables or disables a field (prevents user input). Alias for setReadOnly in newer versions.

methods.name: setLabel
methods.description: Changes the label displayed for a field on the form.

methods.name: getLabelOf
methods.description: Returns the current label text of a field.
methods.example:
var label = g_form.getLabelOf('assigned_to');
console.log('Current label: ' + label);

methods.name: getBooleanValue
methods.description: Returns a boolean value from a checkbox or boolean field (handles string 'true'/'false' conversion).

methods.name: getIntValue
methods.description: Returns the integer value of a field.

methods.name: addDecoration
methods.description: Adds a small icon next to the field label for visual indicators. Icons use the ServiceNow icon font.

methods.name: removeDecoration
methods.description: Removes an icon previously added with addDecoration.
methods.example: g_form.removeDecoration('caller_id', 'icon-star', 'VIP Customer', 'color-gold');

methods.name: hideRelatedLists
methods.description: Hides all related lists on the form.
methods.example:
// Hide all related lists for a cleaner form
g_form.hideRelatedLists();

methods.name: showRelatedLists
methods.description: Shows all related lists on the form.

methods.name: disableAttachments
methods.description: Disables the attachment button on the form.

methods.name: enableAttachments
methods.description: Enables the attachment button on the form.

methods.name: getFormElement
methods.description: Returns the DOM form element.
methods.example: var formEl = g_form.getFormElement();

methods.name: getSectionNames
methods.description: Returns an array of all section names on the form.

methods.name: setAction
methods.description: Sets the form action URL (used before submit).
methods.example: g_form.setAction('incident.do');

methods.name: getActionName
methods.description: Returns the name of the UI Action that triggered the form submission.

methods.name: isReadOnly
methods.description: Returns true if the entire form is read-only.

apis.name: GlideUser (g_user)
apis.description: The GlideUser API provides methods to get information about the current user. Accessed via g_user.

methods.name: getFullName
methods.description: Returns the full name of the current user.
methods.example: alert('Hello ' + g_user.getFullName());

methods.name: hasRole
methods.description: Returns true if the user has the specified role or is an admin.
methods.example: if (g_user.hasRole('itil')) { ... }

methods.name: hasRoleExactly
methods.description: Returns true only if the user has the exact specified role (ignores admin).
methods.example: if (g_user.hasRoleExactly('itil')) { ... }

methods.name: hasRoles
methods.description: Returns true if the user has any roles.
methods.example: if (g_user.hasRoles()) { ... }

methods.name: getClientData
methods.description: Returns a session client data value set by putClientData on the server.

methods.name: hasRoleFromList
methods.description: Returns true if the user has at least one role from a comma-separated list.

properties.name: userName
properties.description: The login username of the current user.

properties.name: userID
properties.description: The sys_id of the current user.

properties.name: firstName
properties.description: The first name of the current user.

properties.name: lastName
properties.description: The last name of the current user.

apis.name: GlideAjax
apis.description: The GlideAjax class enables a client script to call server-side code in a Script Include.

methods.name: Constructor
methods.description: Instantiates a GlideAjax object with the name of the Script Include.
methods.example: var ga = new GlideAjax('HelloWorld');

methods.name: addParam
methods.description: Adds a parameter to the request. Always include 'sysparm_name' for the function name.
methods.example:
ga.addParam('sysparm_name', 'sayHello');
ga.addParam('sysparm_user_name', 'Bob');

methods.name: getXML
methods.description: Sends the request and executes a callback function when the response is received.

methods.name: getXMLAnswer
methods.description: Sends the request and executes a callback function with the 'answer' attribute directly.

methods.name: getXMLWait
methods.description: Sends the AJAX request synchronously (blocks UI). DEPRECATED — use getXMLAnswer with callback instead. Only listed for legacy code reference.

methods.name: getAnswer
methods.description: Returns the answer attribute from a synchronous getXMLWait() call.
methods.example:
// Only use after getXMLWait()
var answer = ga.getAnswer();

methods.name: Script Include Pattern
methods.description: The server-side Script Include must extend AbstractAjaxProcessor. The sysparm_name parameter maps to the function name.

apis.name: GlideElement
apis.description: Represents a single field (column) on a GlideRecord. Every field accessed on a GlideRecord (e.g., gr.short_description) returns a GlideElement, not a raw value. GlideElement provides methods for type checking, display values, change detection, and reference field navigation.

methods.name: getJournalEntry
methods.description: Returns journal field entries (work_notes, comments, etc.) as a formatted string. Pass -1 to get all entries, or a positive number to limit.

methods.name: nil
methods.description: Checks if the field value is null or empty.

methods.name: canWrite
methods.description: Checks if the current user can write to this field.
methods.example: if (current.short_description.canWrite()) { ... }

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Converts the GlideElement value to a JavaScript string. Implicitly called in string concatenation, but explicit use is recommended for clarity.

methods.name: getDisplayValue
methods.description: Returns the display value of the field. For reference fields, returns the display value of the referenced record instead of a sys_id.

methods.name: getReferenceTable
methods.description: Returns the name of the table referenced by a reference field.

methods.name: getRefRecord
methods.description: Returns a GlideRecord object for the record referenced by a reference field. The record is automatically loaded.

methods.name: getED
methods.description: Returns the Element Descriptor (GlideElementDescriptor), providing metadata about the field such as type, length, and attributes.

methods.name: getAttribute
methods.description: Returns the value of a dictionary attribute for the field.

methods.name: getLabel
methods.description: Returns the human-readable label of the field from the dictionary.

methods.name: getTableName
methods.description: Returns the name of the table that contains this field.

methods.name: changes
methods.description: Returns true if the field value has changed in the current transaction. Used in Business Rules.

methods.name: changesFrom
methods.description: Returns true if the field was changed FROM the specified value.

methods.name: changesTo
methods.description: Returns true if the field was changed TO the specified value.

methods.name: getHTMLValue
methods.description: Returns the HTML-formatted value of the field (preserves HTML tags for journal/HTML fields).
methods.example:
var htmlNotes = current.work_notes.getHTMLValue();
gs.info(htmlNotes);

methods.name: getChoices
methods.description: Returns all choice options for a choice field as an array.

methods.name: getBooleanAttribute
methods.description: Returns a boolean dictionary attribute value.
methods.example: var isReadOnly = current.number.getBooleanAttribute('read_only');

methods.name: getDecryptedValue
methods.description: Returns the decrypted value for encrypted fields.
methods.example: var plainText = current.u_encrypted_field.getDecryptedValue();

methods.name: dateNumericValue
methods.description: Returns the numeric value of a date field (ms since epoch).
methods.example:
var ms = current.opened_at.dateNumericValue();
gs.info('Opened at (ms): ' + ms);

methods.name: setDateNumericValue
methods.description: Sets a date field using milliseconds since epoch.
methods.example: current.u_custom_date.setDateNumericValue(Date.now());

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Sets the value of the field.
methods.example: current.short_description.setValue('Updated via GlideElement');

apis.name: GlideAggregate
apis.description: Extension of GlideRecord designed for database aggregation operations (COUNT, SUM, MIN, MAX, AVG) without loading individual records. Significantly more performant than iterating GlideRecord for counting or statistical queries.

methods.name: addAggregate
methods.description: Adds an aggregation operation.

methods.name: getAggregate
methods.description: Retrieves the result of the aggregation.
methods.example: var count = ga.getAggregate('COUNT', 'category');

methods.name: setGroup
